name: canonical-mcp-catalogue
description: Canonical-native MCP servers for charm research, packaging, discovery, and bare-metal substrate (Launchpad, Snapcraft, Charmcraft, MAAS). Read-only verbs are safe by default; publish/edit/capacity verbs require explicit allowed_tools entries.

launchpad.description: Launchpad: bug search, bug view, merge proposals, project lookup. Read-only by default. Modifying verbs (bug_comment, bug_status_set) require an OAuth token and must be opted in via allowed_tools.

snapcraft.description: Snap Store: snap_search, snap_info, snap_releases. Read-only by default. Publish verbs (snap_register, snap_upload, snap_release) require a Snapcraft macaroon (SNAPCRAFT_MACAROON) and must be opted in via allowed_tools.

charmcraft.description: Charmcraft: lint and analyse a local charm directory; second-opinion register/upload/release on Charmhub. Read/inspect verbs (lint, analyse) are safe by default. Publish verbs (register, upload, release) require a Charmhub macaroon (CHARMHUB_MACAROON) and must be opted in via allowed_tools.

maas.description: MAAS: machine inventory and bare-metal provisioning for machine-substrate charm work (kernel modules, GPU passthrough, multi-NIC topologies). Read/inspect verbs (machine_list, machine_view, tag_search, subnet_list, pool_list, version) are safe by default. Capacity-changing verbs (machine_acquire, machine_release, machine_deploy) require a MAAS API key (MAAS_API_KEY) and must be opted in via allowed_tools.
